title: Project
description: A project described by one `craftward.json` file.

current_version.description: Version the maintainer currently ships or is working on.

id.description:
Stable short name used in paths and cross-references.

One to 64 characters from `a-z`, `0-9`, and `-`. It does not start or
end with `-`.

links.description: Links a person would open for this project.

name.description: Human-readable project name. It must contain a non-whitespace character.

schema_version.description: Format generation. Version 1 readers accept only the integer `1`.

source_dir.description:
Directory that holds the project's source code.

A relative path is resolved from the project file. An absolute path is
used as given. `..` is allowed, because the project file may live
outside the repository. When this is absent, the directory that
contains the project file is the source directory.

stack.description: Languages, tools, and lockfiles that make up the project.

status.description: Where the project is in its lifecycle.

tags.description: Labels used to group projects. Exact duplicates are rejected.

updated.description: Day the file was last updated, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

watch_items.description: Dates the maintainer wants to be reminded about.

AndroidConfig.description: Android settings used by the Play target-API check.

detect_from.description:
Gradle and version-catalog files, relative to `source_dir`.

The same rules as `lockfiles`: relative, and no `..` segment.

form_factor.description: Which Play device rules apply. The default is [`FormFactor::Phone`].

min_sdk.description: `minSdk` recorded for the project. The Play check does not use it.

store.description: `google_play` runs the check. `none` skips it. The default is Google Play.

target_sdk.description: `targetSdk` to compare with Play deadlines. When set, files are not read.

AndroidStore.description: Whether the Play deadline check runs.

oneOf.description: Compare `targetSdk` with the Google Play deadlines.
Do not compare `targetSdk`.

Component.description: One piece of a project's stack.

eol_product.description: Product id on endoflife.date, when the name is not a unique match.

note.description: Free-form note about how the component is used.

version.description: Version the project uses, when that is known.

oneOf.description: An operating system or app store platform.
A programming language.
A framework or application library that shapes the program.
A runtime the program executes on.
A vendor SDK.
A hosted or local service the program depends on.
A development or build tool.
A component that does not fit the other roles.

FormFactor.description: Device family whose Play deadline applies.

oneOf.description: Phones and tablets. This is the default.
Android Automotive OS.
Wear OS.
Android TV.
Android XR.

Issue.description: A bug or other tracked problem.

id.description: Short name of the issue, unique among issues in this file.

status.description: Whether the issue is still open.

url.description: Tracker address. It must start with `http://` or `https://` when present.

oneOf.description: Small impact.
Noticeable impact.
Should be handled soon.
Needs attention before other work.
The issue is not being worked on.
Someone is working on the issue.
The issue is fixed.
The issue will not be fixed.

url.description: Address. It must start with `http://` or `https://`.

goal.description: What this phase is meant to achieve.

id.description: Short name of the phase, unique among phases in this file.

tasks.description: Tasks in this phase. Task ids are unique within the phase.

Plan.description: Phased plan for the work that remains.

phases.description: Ordered phases. Phase ids are unique within the file.

oneOf.description: The project has not been started.
The project is being built.
A version has been published.
The project is kept working, without major new work.
Work has stopped for now and may resume.
The project will not be continued.

Stack.description: The technical stack recorded for a project.

android.description: Android `targetSdk` settings. Absent means Play deadlines are not checked.

components.description: Named pieces of the stack, such as a language or a hosted service.

lockfiles.description:
Lockfiles or other dependency manifests, relative to `source_dir`.

When `source_dir` is absent, they are relative to the project file's
directory. Each path must be relative. Absolute paths and `..`
segments are rejected.

due.description: Day the task is due, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

id.description: Short name of the task, unique among tasks in its phase.

status.description: Whether the task is still open.

oneOf.description: Nobody has started the task.
The task is underway.
The task is finished.
The task will not be done.

WatchItem.description: A dated reminder that is not a task or an issue.

due.description: The day this reminder is about, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

id.description: Short name of the reminder, unique among watch items in this file.

kind.description: What kind of date this is.

oneOf.description: A date by which something must happen.
A date on which something stops being valid.
A date on which the project should be reviewed.
A dated reminder of another kind.
